content.page_header_note: For ESC Guidelines: The report below lists declarations of interest as reported to the ESC by the experts during the yearly call for declaration conducted every January covering the previous calendar year. The calls for declaration are conducted during the period of development of these guidelines up to and including 2021.

entries: Travel and meeting support from healthcare industry, independent of the above activities. Several: I receive expenses for travel from many sources, as an independent patient advocate and conference speaker.
Research funding (personal) from healthcare industry. Several: I receive honoraria from research grants or budgets for my work as an independent patient advocate.

Other Positions of Influence: Any other interest (financial or otherwise) that should be declared in view of holding an ESC position. I am an independent patient advocate and in the past that has involved consultancy work with industry and charities and government bodies. I do not hold any such posts or roles currently.

Financial Declaration: Direct personal payment from healthcare industry: speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator, committee member, etc. For yourself - BMC: Medical publishing.
